operativeInput: Both use id IDS.first, provider stripe, stored OFFER(month), requested year snapshot with catalog price_trial_month/price_trial_year/coupon_trial_year. Donor input/stored user are both null; keeper input/stored user are both IDS.profile. Owner only validates UUID when non-null and compares stored user to input user. assertionUnion: Donor exact from(trial_enrollments) is already asserted by pgliteAdmissionClient.from during keeper calls.
Donor exact select(id,user_id,provider,accepted_offer) is already asserted by the same keeper helper.
Donor assert.rejects /does not match accepted terms/ is keeper first annual changed iteration, with actual INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and SQL readback.
Keeper additionally preserves repeated successful creation, exact upsert options, eq(id), other-user/provider refusal and final persisted monthly row.
whyC: Existing storage-backed owner call subsumes mocked transport readback; no cloned implementation or new input. The keeper rejection comes from actual createTrialEnrollment, not mock-built status.
risk: The creator currently has only test callers. This proposal retains it and all other creator/live-admission contracts; no retirement or source cleanup is claimed. PGlite is one connection and not a live two-session race proof.
